In this experiment, you will investigate the heating of a thermometer bulb.
Carry out the following instructions, referring to Figs. 2.1 and 2.2.

You are provided with a lamp and a rule. Do notmove the lamp or the rule. During the
experiment, you will read temperature values from the thermometer. You should use the card
provided to shield your eyes from the direct rays of the lamp.

parts.text:
A student suggests that θV will be higher than the thermometer reading θH because
thermal energy will travel by infra-red radiation and convection to the thermometer bulb
above the lamp but by infra-red radiation only when the bulb is to one side of the lamp.
If the experiment were to be repeated in order to investigate this suggestion, it would
be important to control the conditions. Suggest two such conditions, relevant to this
investigation, that should be controlled.
